title: Babies on Picnic Table by Clothesline, 1930s Outdoor Family Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate Depression-era backyard snapshot capturing two infants seated atop a rustic wooden picnic table bathed in dappled sunlight. Next to them, older siblings sit playing or resting, while freshly washed linens hang from a clothesline among the trees in the leafy background. The reverse side features mounting paper remnants from an old photo album and a faint circular processing mark.
